name: Gastrointestinal motility and gastric secretion regulation
reason: GI smooth muscle contraction, gastric motility and acid secretion; nutrient-response member fits gut physiology loosely.

name: Biotin-carboxylase metabolism and respiratory-chain prenylated cofactor biosynthesis
reason: Biotin/HLCS/BTD and MUT (propionate catabolism) vs ubiquinone and heme A biosynthesis; only a generic cofactor link.

name: TLR-MyD88-NF-kB inflammatory cytokine signalling and its deficiencies
reason: TLR/MyD88/IRAK4/IKK deficiencies plus TNF/IL-6/IL-8 production and inflammatory response all form one innate pathway.

name: Glucagon-PKA regulation of hepatic glucose metabolism
reason: Glucagon secretion/response, PKA activation, gluconeogenesis regulation and AMPK-ChREBP are one hepatic fuel axis.

name: Rab/ARF GTPase-regulated endosomal trafficking at synapses
reason: Rab/ARF signalling and TBC RabGAPs linked to synaptic vesicle endosomal recycling and postsynaptic receptor internalization.

name: Left-right patterning/Nodal antagonism, liver development, PD-L1 regulation
reason: Large LR asymmetry/Nodal-BMP sequestration block, separate liver development/regeneration block, PD-L1/tumour T-cell block and ER insertion; no specific link.

name: RHOBTB atypical Rho GTPase cycles
reason: Three RHOBTB GTPase cycles form the core; KLF12 targets and a loose unrelated BTM module do not belong (40%).

name: DNA glycosylase-initiated base excision repair and defects
reason: All members are BER glycosylase steps (OGG1, MUTYH, NTHL1, NEILs, APEX1) or single-strand break repair.

name: 3'UTR-mediated post-transcriptional mRNA regulation
reason: mRNA destabilization via AUF1/3'UTR, translational repression and mRNA localization are RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA fate.

name: Nucleoside monophosphate salvage and deoxynucleotide catabolism
reason: dNMP/dN catabolism, UMP salvage and CMP/dCMP metabolism are nucleotide salvage/turnover.

name: LPS sensing via LBP-CD14 and inflammatory leukocyte recruitment
reason: LPS detection, LBP-CD14 transfer and LPS signalling with inflammatory chemotaxis form one response.

name: Centrosome organisation and microtubule nucleation
reason: Centrosome positioning, cohesion, maturation, MT nucleation/anchoring, AURKA-TPX2; CIT and actin localization are minor odd members.

name: VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis regulation
reason: All members regulate endothelial proliferation, sprouting angiogenesis and VEGF signalling/production.

name: Vitamin C/E metabolism and globin oxygen transport
reason: Ascorbate transport/metabolism and vitamin E response vs oxygen transport (globins/cytoglobin, stellate activation) and integrin biosynthesis; no specific link.

name: Chemokine and chemokine receptor signalling
reason: Chemokine clusters, receptor binding, CXCR4, NK chemotaxis and mature DC (CCR7) differentiation share chemokine biology.

name: Extracellular matrix and stromal TGF-beta signalling genes
reason: ECM/collagen-TGFB modules and UV-down (ECM/receptor-rich) genes; vague membrane signal transduction module fits loosely.

name: APC-T cell costimulation and CD4 T cell activation
reason: TCR-MHC contact, costimulation, DC activation and CD4 proliferation describe the immunological synapse.

name: Interferon-gamma signalling and its regulation
reason: All members are IFN-gamma (type II IFN) signalling and its regulation.

name: Maternal mRNA clearance at maternal-to-zygotic transition
reason: MZT, M-decay, Z-decay and deadenylation are one process.

name: Nutrient and energy regulation of mTORC1 signalling
reason: Amino acid/leucine and LKB1-AMPK regulation of mTORC1.

name: Skeletal, cartilage and joint development
reason: Chondrogenesis, osteoblast/ossification, joint, tendon, suture and limb bud development.

name: Chemokine signalling and monocyte recruitment
reason: Chemokines/receptors and chemotaxis with monocyte differentiation.

name: Endocardial, trabecular and coronary vessel heart development
reason: Endocardium, trabeculation and coronary vasculogenesis are linked cardiac morphogenesis.

name: Thymic T cell development and selection
reason: All members concern thymocyte differentiation, proliferation, selection and survival.

name: Cellular response to UV radiation
reason: Four UV response members; growth rate and adult lifespan are a third that only loosely ties via DNA damage-aging.

name: Host-virus interaction and regulation of viral life cycle
reason: All members regulate viral entry, replication, release or host restriction.

name: SLC24 sodium/calcium-potassium exchangers and their disorders
reason: SLC24A1/4/5 defects and Na/Ca exchangers.

name: Translational stress: stress granules and ribosome quality control
reason: Stress granule assembly/disassembly and RQC/ZNF598 stalled-ribosome rescue, linked as responses to stalled translation.

name: RIPK1/RIPK3 necroptosis and microbial modulation
reason: Necroptosis signalling, microbial RIPK1 modulation and SARS-CoV-1 cell-death effects.

name: Nitric oxide-cGMP signalling
reason: All members are NO-mediated/cGMP signalling.

name: Neuronal axodendritic cargo and vesicle transport
reason: Dense core vesicle, synaptic vesicle and receptor transport in neurons; MT depolymerization a minor odd member.

name: Cholesterol and lipoprotein homeostasis incl. receptor endocytosis
reason: LXR, HDL/LDL, cholesterol efflux/synthesis, foam cells, with LDLR-family receptor internalization/recycling; fibrinogen minor odd.

name: LXR-regulated triglyceride and VLDL metabolism
reason: LXR control of lipogenesis and lipolysis plus VLDL remodelling.

name: Pentose phosphate and glucuronate-xylulose pathway
reason: Non-oxidative PPP enzymes/deficiencies, xylulose-5-P and glucuronate/pentosuria.

name: Xenobiotic and drug metabolism (ADME)
reason: Drug ADME, sulfonation, xenobiotic/toxin catabolism and steroid metabolism by shared enzymes.

name: Keratan sulfate biosynthesis
reason: All members are keratan sulfate metabolism including CHST6 defect.

name: Axial mesoderm/notochord and dorsoventral axis formation
reason: Notochord/axial mesoderm formation and D/V axis specification are organiser-derived patterning.

name: Negative regulation of integrin adhesion and Rho/Rac signalling
reason: All members inhibit integrin/cell-matrix adhesion and Rho/Rac-driven lamellipodia.

name: Retinoid (vitamin A) metabolism
reason: Retinol/retinal metabolism and transport; hydrocarbon metabolism is a generic parent.

name: TLR-mediated bacterial sensing in myeloid cells
reason: TLR2/3/4/5 regulation, LPS/lipopeptide/LTA responses, MyD88/IRAK4, IL-1/IL-37, myeloid modules; Dengue apoptosis is a minor odd member.
